answer: Unique-challenge registry: each agent must solve a one-time puzzle derived from a copper-seeded nonce before acting, and the seed rotates per request, so replaying a captured answer fails. Registration also demands a fresh pigment pattern read from a physical token, binding identity to an unrepeatable artifact. Attacker cost: one hardware token plus a live solve per identity, making bulk tundra-scale farming economically prohibitive since no answer can be reused.
